headline: Hello friend.
letter: Thank you for taking the time to view my portfolio. It means a lot to me that you're here.

My name is Patrick, and for 14-years I've had the opportunity to lead brands for rapidly growing tech startups, design identities for dozens of small businesses, tell the stories of inspirational people, helped a major AI model become more inclusive, and hung from a belt off the side of a helicopter over the Mariana Trench.
I enjoy working side-by-side with engineers and leadership to break down complex topics and present them in a way anyone can understand.
If something you see here inspires you, please reach out.
